name: bidsonar
description: Search UK and EU public-sector contracts, grants, buyers and suppliers from BidSonar's live directory.

interface.longDescription:
BidSonar is a live directory of UK and EU public-sector contracts, grants, buyers, suppliers and sectors. Ask in plain English to find open tenders and grants, filter by value, deadline, country, region and status, open the full record for a notice, see which suppliers a public body has awarded work to, explore a sector's top buyers and latest opportunities, and check which official sources BidSonar covers and how fresh each one is.

The data comes from Contracts Finder, Find a Tender, eTenders Ireland, TED (Tenders Electronic Daily), Innovate UK and UKRI. Values keep their source currency and are labelled as estimated, exact, range or undisclosed. BidSonar never converts currencies or adds amounts across currencies. Every result links to its BidSonar page and, where available, the official source notice.

Who it's for: businesses that bid for public-sector work, bid and sales teams, consultants, and researchers following UK and EU public spending.

Limitations: BidSonar is read-only. It can't submit bids or applications, save opportunities, or change anything in your BidSonar account. Coverage follows the official feeds listed above, so a notice published only on another portal won't appear. Signing in needs a BidSonar account.
capabilities: Look up buyers, suppliers and award history
Browse sectors and their top buyers
defaultPrompt: Show me open healthcare contracts over £500k closing in the next 30 days
What has NHS Property Services awarded recently, and to whom?
Find open Innovate UK grants for climate tech

positive.description: Filtered search for open contracts by sector, minimum value and deadline window.
positive.prompt: Show me open healthcare contracts over £500k closing in the next 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: A list of open healthcare-related contracts with a disclosed value of at least £500,000 and a deadline within the next 30 days. Each item shows the buyer, the value in its source currency, the deadline and a bidsonar.com link. No awarded or closed notices appear.

positive.description: Buyer award history: which suppliers a named public body has awarded contracts to.
positive.prompt: What has NHS Property Services awarded recently, and to whom?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists NHS Property Services' recently awarded contracts, newest first, each with the winning supplier, the disclosed award value in its source currency and the publication date, with links to the BidSonar notices.

positive.description: Grant discovery by funder and topic.
positive.prompt: Find open Innovate UK grants for climate tech.
positive.expected_behavior: A list of open grants funded by Innovate UK relating to climate, net zero or clean technology, each with its funder, deadline where published, and links to the BidSonar page and the official competition page.

positive.description: Sector overview: top buyers and recent opportunities in one sector.
positive.prompt: Who are the biggest buyers in the construction sector, and what are its latest opportunities?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the construction sector's top buyers by number of opportunities and lists its most recent opportunities with buyer, status and bidsonar.com links.

positive.prompt: Which data sources does BidSonar cover, and how up to date is each one?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the six official feeds (Contracts Finder, Find a Tender, eTenders Ireland, TED, Innovate UK and UKRI) with publisher, what each covers, how often it refreshes, and the date of the newest notice from each.

negative.description: Write action the plugin doesn't support. BidSonar is read-only, so no tool should be called to submit anything; the assistant should explain that bids are submitted on the buyer's own portal.
negative.prompt: Submit a bid on my behalf for the first NHS tender you can find.

negative.description: Request unrelated to public procurement. No BidSonar tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather forecast for Belfast tomorrow?

negative.description: Personal contact data BidSonar doesn't hold. The assistant should not invent a phone number or present one as coming from BidSonar.
negative.prompt: Give me the personal mobile number of the procurement officer at Belfast City Council.

publication.release_notes: First release: search and look up UK and EU public-sector contracts, grants, buyers, suppliers and sectors, with source coverage and freshness.
